```yaml
name: Release Precompiled Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
  RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
  CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI: "true"

jobs:
  create-release:
    name: Create Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
      tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Validate version matches Cargo.toml
        run: |
          TAG_VERSION="${{ github.ref_name }}"
          TAG_VERSION="${TAG_VERSION#v}"
          CARGO_VERSION=$(grep -E "^version\s*=" Cargo.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
          if [[ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$CARGO_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Version mismatch: tag=$TAG_VERSION, Cargo.toml=$CARGO_VERSION"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create Draft Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false

  build-cli:
    name: Build CLI Binary (${{ matrix.target }})
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Linux x86_64
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            features: ""
            cuda: ""
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            features: cuda
            cuda: "11.8"
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            features: cuda
            cuda: "12.4"
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            features: cuda
            cuda: "13.0"
          # Linux aarch64
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            features: ""
            cuda: ""
          # macOS arm64
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
            features: metal
            cuda: ""
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install lld
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-20.04'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lld

      - name: Install CUDA Toolkit
        if: matrix.cuda != ''
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.1
        with:
          cuda: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
          method: network

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu'
        run: |
          cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Cache cargo registry & build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.target }}-

      - name: Build CLI Binary
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ]]; then
            cross build --release -p cake-cli --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features ${{ matrix.features }}
          else
            cargo build --release -p cake-cli --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features ${{ matrix.features }}
          fi

      - name: Package Binary
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          BIN_NAME="cake"
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-apple-darwin" ]]; then
            ARCHIVE_NAME="cake-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz"
          else
            ARCHIVE_NAME="cake-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.cuda }}.tar.gz"
          fi
          tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" "$BIN_NAME"
          sha256sum "$ARCHIVE_NAME" > "${ARCHIVE_NAME}.sha256"

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cli-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.cuda }}
          path: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}*.tar.gz*

  build-mobile:
    name: Build Mobile Library (${{ matrix.target }})
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Android aarch64
          - target: aarch64-linux-android
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            features: ""
            arch: arm64-v8a
          # iOS arm64
          - target: aarch64-apple-ios
            os: macos-latest
            features: metal
            arch: ""
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install cargo-ndk
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-linux-android'
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-ndk

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-ios'
        run: |
          cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Cache cargo registry & build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.target }}-

      - name: Build Mobile Library
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-linux-android" ]]; then
            cargo ndk -t aarch64-linux-android build --release -p cake-mobile --features ${{ matrix.features }}
          elif [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-apple-ios" ]]; then
            cross build --release -p cake-mobile --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features ${{ matrix.features }}
          fi

      - name: Package Mobile Library
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-linux-android" ]]; then
            LIB_NAME="libcake_mobile.so"
            ARCHIVE_NAME="cake-mobile-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz"
          elif [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == "aarch64-apple-ios" ]]; then
            LIB_NAME="libcake_mobile.a"
            ARCHIVE_NAME="cake-mobile-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz"
          fi
          tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" "$LIB_NAME"
          sha256sum "$ARCHIVE_NAME" > "${ARCHIVE_NAME}.sha256"

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mobile-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake-mobile-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}*.tar.gz*

  upload-assets:
    name: Upload Assets to Release
    needs: [create-release, build-cli, build-mobile]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download All Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Upload Release Assets
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: artifacts/**/*
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          overwrite: true
          draft: true
```
